From the owner
Before & After: A Complete Kitchen Transformation The Stone Company transformed this kitchen with expert craftsmanship, thoughtful design and exceptional value. By refinishing and painting the original cabinets Antique white, we created a fresh, timeless foundation while preserving the layout and character the homeowners already loved. From there, we elevated the space with new hardware, Durable Quartz countertops, an undermount sink, a beautiful tile backsplash and updated light fixtures. The quartz’s subtle veining, crisp black hardware and elegant glass lighting work together to create a bright, cohesive kitchen that feels polished, welcoming and built to last. New flooring and a fresh coat of paint completed the renovation, tying every element together and giving the entire space a renewed sense of style. These before-and-after photos demonstrate the power of a well-planned renovation: homeowners can achieve a dramatic transformation without replacing everything. By preserving the original cabinets and focusing on high-impact upgrades, The Stone Company delivered a beautiful, functional kitchen with lasting value. “I’m grateful to all my customers present and past for trusting me to bring their vision to life!”-Nick Buehler / Owner

reviews.text: “Skyline Cabinet Painting has had the pleasure of working alongside this granite and stone company on projects, and they have been excellent to work with. Their team is professional, dependable, and delivers beautiful craftsmanship that really helps bring the whole project together. The quality of their stone work adds a high-end finish that makes a big difference in the final result. We always appreciate working with companies that care about detail and customer satisfaction, and they definitely do. We highly recommend them to anyone looking for quality granite and stone work.”

Jason, we appreciate the partnership and the trust!  Working alongside Skyline Cabinet Painting allows us to deliver complete, high-end kitchen and interior transformations for homeowners here in St. Charles and the greater St. Louis area.

Your cabinet refinishing and interior painting skills pairs perfectly with our Quartz and Granite countertop installations, tile backsplash installations and full kitchen Refreshes. That level of detail and experience is what brings everything together and creates the finished product our clients expect.
At The Stone Company we value working with professionals who take pride in their craft and customer experience. Looking forward to many more projects together!

facts.about_text: The Stone Company is a high-end kitchen and bath remodeling company serving St. Louis, St. Charles, and the surrounding areas. We specialize in quartz and granite countertops, tile backsplash installations, cabinet upgrades, custom trim and carpentry, fireplace build-outs, under-cabinet lighting, electrical and plumbing coordination, and full kitchen refresh projects.
